agent_server.role: ASX Manager route planning, cache, and JSON-RPC app

json_runtime_object_server.role: JSON/XCFE object server and project-user file manager

model_server.role: local model server or llama.cpp-compatible model surface

grpc_compat.role: optional gRPC compatibility bridge for Workspace/Window/Chat/Model services; not the default JSON runtime port

@file_manager.rule: Paths are relative to session_root/user_id/project_id. Absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.

@folds.rule: Folds are the primary semantic runtime states. Phase is mathematical manifold metadata attached to each fold. Nodes/ops perform work; XCFE rotates legal movement between folds.

gravity_wells.rule: Fold gravity wells bias routing before execution. They score context, nodes, tools, models, batches, and threads against phase attraction/repulsion fields, then collapse to the highest legal fold.

pop.purpose: Acquire request context, user/project scope, sidecar declarations, and file/object references.

wo.purpose: Bind symbols, route names, API verbs, object aliases, and sidecar capabilities.

yax.purpose: Build the XCFE chart: selected nodes, legal route order, guards, and re-entry plan.

sek.purpose: Execute admitted deterministic nodes and sidecar operations.

chen.purpose: Emit artifacts, route results, sidecar panel events, and serialized object state.

xul.purpose: Validate, record provenance, update memory/replay, and close or re-enter the chart.

@sidecars._comment: Each key = sidecar name; path = JSON sidecar file
@sidecars._rule: Sidecar JSON is a bootstrap executable contract for apps, games, programs, websites, schemas, and tools. It is treated as executable notation when backed by @ops, @dispatch_schema, @routes, @entry, or @schema.

_app_contract.purpose: Every JSON app/game/program/website/RPC pack/MCP pack/network/API client pack/GPU pack/.NET/Roslyn compiler pack/Windows script host pack/native build pack/user pack/session pack/database pack/project pack/action pack/command pack/tool pack/bot pack/Micronaut pack/model pack/BSON data pack/agent pack/batch pack/thread pack/process pack/skill pack/log pack/event pack/parser pack/validator pack/compiler pack/generator pack/glyph pack/fold pack/node pack/phase pack/program pack may ship its own manifest sidecar that declares static REST/API routes, localhost ports, RPC methods, MCP tools/resources, HTTP clients, curl transfers, GPU providers, compiler tools, Windows scripting hosts, CMake/CTest/CPack tools, Visual Studio developer shells, users, sessions, databases, projects, commands, tools, bots, models, GGUF/MGGUF artifacts, BSON documents, schemas, DI bindings, schedules, logs, events, parsers, validators, compilers, generators, agents, batches, threads, processes, skills, glyphs, lanes, opcodes, phases, folds, nodes, programs, and UI/assets. Loading it mounts those declarations as executable XCFE/KUHUL nodes.
_app_contract.route_rule: Ports and localhost route names must be declared in JSON before execution. Multiple app manifests can be mounted independently; no app depends on server.manifest.json specifically.
_app_contract.phase_bundle_rule: Individual phase bundles such as pop.manifest.json and sek.manifest.json can be mounted alone, but must still declare their phase id, inputs, outputs, legal nodes, and guards.
_app_contract.bot_rule: bots.manifest.json declares bot categories, helper methods, pipeline shapes, and localhost endpoints. bots.cpp is the native adapter layer that turns those declarations into deterministic bot-helper payloads.
_app_contract.rpc_rule: rpc.manifest.json declares JSON-RPC methods, params, result schemas, and route bindings. It should map method names onto actions, tools, sidecar calls, or XCFE programs.
_app_contract.mcp_rule: mcp.manifest.json declares MCP server identity, tools, resources, prompts, transports, and permissions. MCP manifests expose tool contracts; they do not bypass local route admission.
_app_contract.network_rule: network.manifest.json, http.manifest.json, and api-client.manifest.json declare HTTP/API clients, curl.exe, request templates, headers, auth policy, endpoints, downloads, and transfer rules. Network tools are admitted per route and should not bypass manifest allowlists.
_app_contract.gpu_rule: gpu.manifest.json declares universal graphics and compute providers such as Direct2D/d2d1, Direct3D 9/10/11/12, D3D12Core, d3dconfig.exe, Direct3D debug layer, WARP/software rendering, d3d11on12 compatibility for D3D11-over-D3D12, D3DCompiler/D3DX legacy shader/helper libraries, DXC/dxcompiler/dxil Shader Model 6 lanes for native D3D12/DXIL shaders, app overrides, webgpu, webgl2, Three.js, OrbitControls, web graphics assets, opencl, CPU fallback, kernels, lanes, feature gates, and dispatch policy. It declares available compute/assets; XCFE/KUHUL still decides when a node may use them.
_app_contract.dotnet_roslyn_rule: dotnet.manifest.json and roslyn.manifest.json declare .NET compiler tools such as dotnet.exe, csc.exe, vbc.exe, VBCSCompiler.exe, dotnet-format.exe, MSBuild, analyzers, source generators, SDK workload manifests, localized WorkloadManifest.*.json files, and toolchain capability indexes. Workload families include Emscripten, Mono toolchain, Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, macOS, MAUI, and tvOS. They are tool declarations for parse/validate/compile/generate manifests, not mandatory runtime dependencies.
_app_contract.windows_desktop_rule: windows-desktop.manifest.json declares Microsoft.WindowsDesktop.App runtime paths, WPF, WinForms, WebView2, WWAHost/UWP HTML-CSS-JS host surfaces, apphost, desktop packaging, terminal panels, game shells, and local desktop app builder capabilities.
_app_contract.windows_script_host_rule: windows-script-host.manifest.json and scripts.manifest.json declare cmd.exe for Command Prompt and .bat/.cmd execution, py.exe as the Windows Python Launcher for version-selected Python scripts, cscript.exe for terminal text-mode Windows Script Host execution, wscript.exe for windowed script execution, VBScript/JScript files, script arguments, stdout/stderr handling, and sandbox/admission policy.
_app_contract.native_build_rule: cmake.manifest.json, visual-studio-tools.manifest.json, and native-build.manifest.json declare CMake, CTest, CPack, cmake-gui, cmcldeps, MSVC toolchains, Visual Studio Developer Command Prompt shortcuts, generators, toolchain files, presets, tests, and package commands. They are native build tool declarations; XCFE decides when to invoke them.
_app_contract.user_rule: user.manifest.json declares user identity, preferences, scoped memory, permissions, and retention policy. User history remains user-scoped.
_app_contract.session_rule: session.manifest.json declares conversation/session identity, history pointers, current working state, runtime mounts, and replay retention.
_app_contract.database_rule: database.manifest.json declares database providers, tables, indexes, queries, migrations, and BSON/SCXQ2 storage policy.
_app_contract.project_rule: projects.manifest.json declares project/workspace roots, project-scoped agents, file-manager policy, routes, and mount permissions.
_app_contract.logs_events_rule: logs.manifest.json and events.manifest.json declare trace, audit, notification, replay, and event-stream contracts.
_app_contract.parse_validate_compile_generate_rule: parse.manifest.json, validate.manifest.json, compile.manifest.json, and generate.manifest.json declare lifecycle tools for AST/KAST construction, admission checks, build targets, and artifact generation.
_app_contract.glyph_rule: glyphs.manifest.json declares surface forms and typed symbol bindings. Glyphs, lanes, and opcodes are equivalent only after the opcode resolver binds a glyph to an executable lane inside a legal phase.
_app_contract.bson_rule: bson.manifest.json declares BSON collections/documents and their decode/index/cache policy. SCXQ2 remains the ASX binary format; BSON manifests may use SCXQ2 lanes for compression, transport, storage, replay, and binary execution envelopes.
_app_contract.agent_rule: agents.manifest.json declares executable agent objects and their allowed actions, tools, routes, folds, and memory scope.
_app_contract.model_rule: models.manifest.json declares model identities such as OSS, LFM, Gemma, local GGUF/MGGUF artifact paths, model-server routes, adapters, providers, and fold/node load policies. GGUF is the universal local model artifact format; the manifest decides what is allowed to mount and when.
_app_contract.batch_thread_process_rule: batches.manifest.json, threads.manifest.json, and processes.manifest.json declare scheduling and execution topology. They mount runnable units; they do not bypass XCFE admission.
_app_contract.skill_rule: skills.manifest.json declares reusable capability contracts and maps them to actions, tools, bots, agents, or sidecar calls.
_app_contract.xjson_xcfe_rule: xjson.manifest.json and xcfe.manifest.json declare the split-authority language surface, canonical AST, static verifier, runtime walk, standard @verb library, pack schema, canonical JSON hashing, proof envelope, policy law, and optional crypto/SCX chain packs. XJSON declares visible existence and expression boundaries; XCFE is the only execution authority.
_app_contract.grammar_rule: grammar.manifest.json declares lexical tokens, block syntax, expression boundaries, labels, indentation lowering, AST paths, canonicalization, and deterministic parser test vectors. Grammar mounts notation; it does not execute by itself.
_app_contract.class_rule: classes.manifest.json declares type/class/object contracts for @class, @new, @array, @map, @object, fields, constructors, invariants, and schema links. Classes are state/type contracts until admitted by XCFE verbs.
_app_contract.ir_rule: ir.manifest.json declares the frozen KIMD x K'UHUL x SVG unified IR, screen vector graphics surface law, pure opcode set, replay log format, SVG tessellation mapping, D3D11_1 matrix-rendering projection, tiny-character loop, animated cartoon character rigs, and local native projection roots. It is an authority-plane contract until admitted by XCFE/KUHUL execution.
_app_contract.animated_character_demo_rule: Animated character demos such as steamboat-willie-vector-character.manifest.json must use procedural vectors/tensors and public-domain-safe references. They must not embed copied frames, protected branding, or later character designs.

@server.http_file_rule: The HTTP object server resolves /api/file paths under $http_file_path. $http_file_path may alias $host_directory, $manifest_directory, $root, or a manifest-relative directory. Request paths stay relative and are traversal-guarded.

split.rule: Authority declares and classifies what may exist; execution hosts and runs admitted runtime actions.
split.micronaut_model_rule: models.manifest.json, micronaut model xjson, GGUF/SCXQDDS/API backend records, tools, and registry entries remain authority-plane declarations until an admitted XCFE/model adapter call enters the execution half.
